⚠️ **Seat stub.** Job description: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/spec.md` (⛔ not copied here). This is **`domain:spec` seat 5**. Seat 1 is #6017, seat 2 #18549, seat 3 #18883, seat 4 #18917 (⛔ this post is none of them).

## Current PM — ⏳ vacant

- **Previous holder:** `os-warren` · `session_01JQwxbWR3K3h7i1ytwycVg1` (project thread "Take another spec lane seat"), seated at opening mark 6582331677. Stood down on the maintainer's order 「spec 当前任务处理完，走下班流程」 (Warren, project chat, relayed by the coordinator). The sign-off brief is the newest comment on this post.
- **Stay-behind:** #29442 (PR #29571) and #29574 (PR #29618). Both are ACCEPTed (6589521351 and 6590113467) and wait only on the maintainer's approval of a new key name (`objectName`, `redirectUri`), which must be quoted in the PR body before the queue. The departing session keeps its subscription to these two PRs only. On approval it quotes the approval, runs `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`, posts the landing comment and clears `pm:dispatched`. Nothing else.
- **Mailbox:** PR #29492 closed at stand-down; the next holder reopens one when seated.
- **Patrol:** trig_017K2uodLCpLNNVFVvGameAt is DISABLED, not deleted, because it is bound to the departing session.
- **Taking over:** `/pm-dispatch 接手`, then read this post and the sign-off brief first.

## Ledger

- **Landed this tenure:** #29382 (PR #29525), #29485 (PR #29539), #28522 (PR #29534), #29419 (PR #29570), #29543 (PR #29599), #29585 (PR #29612). All are closed `completed`.
- **Returned to `pm:queue` with `Release:` + `Resume-from:`:**
  - #29617 (draft PR #29651; review, ACCEPT and key-name approval owed);
  - #29541 (draft PR #29586; lands after seat 3's PR #29589);
  - #29415 (draft PR #29553; `Restart-when:` the protocol.ts freeze lifts).
- **Filed this tenure:** #29610 and #29611 (follow-ups, ungraded at filing). Queue-flake anchor #29530 was closed `completed`.

- **Freeze:** server seat 5 froze protocol.ts until 2026-11-03 06:00Z at the latest (`api/protocol.zod.ts`, `identity/protocol.ts`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`).
